description: This Java class defines a factory for creating custom Akka HTTP rejection handlers, specifically handling missing query parameter rejections with a custom 400 Bad Request response message.

classes.name: DittoRejectionHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create custom RejectionHandler instances with specific handling for missing query parameters.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new custom RejectionHandler with handling for missing query parameters.

methods.name: handleMissingQueryParam
methods.description: Handles missing query parameter rejections by returning a BAD_REQUEST response with a custom message.
